piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Name, country and introductions
texto: Integrated speaking: introducing yourself and asking the other person a question. In face-to-face conversation, it is common to follow your introduction with a question in return: «ยินดีที่ได้รู้จักครับ/ค่ะ» (Nice to meet you) or «แล้วคุณล่ะครับ/คะ» (And you?). Practise the rising intonation of questions with «คะ» (high tone), and say the name of your country clearly in Thai.
